componentes.descripcion:
ArrowDetailsIcon Component

A reusable arrow-in-circle icon component.
Commonly used for viewing more details or expanding information.

BrandingIcon Component

A reusable branding/paintbrush icon component.
Commonly used for branding settings, customization, and design options.

CalendarIcon Component

A reusable calendar icon component.
Commonly used for date pickers, scheduling features, and appointment management.

CheckIcon Component

A reusable checkmark/check circle icon component.
Commonly used for success states, task completion, and list items.

CheckmarkIcon Component

A simple checkmark icon (without circle).
Used for list items, feature highlights, and confirmation states.

ClinicalNotesIcon component
Displays a clinical notes icon

CityIcon component
Displays a building/city icon for city-related UI elements

ClockIcon component
Displays a clock icon for time/date-related UI elements

CopyIcon component
Displays a copy icon

CoinsAcceptedIcon component
Displays a coins accepted icon

DocumentIcon Component

A reusable document/file icon component.
Commonly used for viewing documents, prescriptions, or records.

DragHandleIcon Component

A reusable drag handle icon component showing grip dots.
Commonly used to indicate draggable items.

EditIcon Component

A reusable pencil/edit icon component.
Commonly used for edit or modify actions.

EmailIcon component
Displays an envelope icon for email-related UI elements

ErrorIcon Component

A reusable error icon component showing an X inside a circle.
Commonly used for error states, validation failures, and alert messages.

FilterIcon Component

A reusable filter/funnel icon component.
Commonly used for filter actions and filtering controls.

FoldersIcon component
Displays a folders icon

InfoIcon Component

A reusable info/information icon component.
Commonly used to display help text, tips, or additional information.

LocationIcon component
Displays a map pin/location icon for address-related UI elements

ManualIdentifierIcon Component

A reusable icon component representing manually-entered identifiers.
The icon shows a pen/pencil symbol to represent user input and manual entry.

MapIcon component
Displays a map icon for state/region-related UI elements

MoreIcon component
Displays a vertical three-dot menu icon for more options/actions

NotificationIcon Component

A reusable notification/bell icon component.
Commonly used for notification settings, alerts, and updates.

PatientListIcon component
Displays a patient list icon

PhoneIcon component
Displays a phone icon for contact-related UI elements

WhatsAppIcon component
Displays the WhatsApp logo icon

PlusIcon Component

A reusable plus/add icon component.
Commonly used for actions like creating new items or adding records.

PrintIcon Component

A reusable printer/print icon component.
Commonly used for printing documents or opening print formats.

RefreshIcon Component

A reusable refresh/restore icon component.
Commonly used for refresh, reload, or restore actions.

SearchIcon Component

A reusable search/magnifying glass icon component.
Commonly used in search inputs and filter actions.

SortIcon Component

A reusable sort icon component showing ascending/descending arrows.
Commonly used for sorting actions and controls.

SystemIdentifierIcon Component

A reusable icon component representing system-generated identifiers.
The icon shows a gear/cog symbol to represent automated system generation.

TrashIcon Component

A reusable trash/delete icon component.
Commonly used for delete or remove actions.

UsersIcon Component

A reusable users/people icon component showing multiple users.
Commonly used for viewing lists of users or patients.

TargetIcon Component

A target/crosshair icon for selection, focus, or goal indication.

componentes.descripcion:
Presentational full-screen loading overlay. It is fully controlled: the
consumer decides when it is `visible` and which `message` it shows, so the
same component can express every loading state (boot, sign-in, sign-out,…).
It keeps no state and performs no side effects — the fade in/out is CSS only.

props.descripcion: Whether the overlay is shown. When false it fades out and stops capturing pointer events.
Extra class applied to the root overlay element.
Primary line describing what is happening (e.g. "Estamos cargando la aplicación").
Accessible label for the spinner (screen readers). Defaults to the message or "Cargando".
Optional emphasized heading rendered above the message.
Tone for the spinner accent.

componentes.descripcion:
Contained, non-blocking loading indicator. Unlike `OverlayLoader` it flows
inside its parent (no fixed positioning), so it can fill just a content
region — e.g. the microfrontend slot while its bundle mounts — without
covering the rest of the shell (the sidebar stays interactive).

props.descripcion: Extra class applied to the root element.

Stretch to fill the available width and height of the parent and center
its content, instead of rendering as a compact inline card. Use it when the
loader owns a whole region (e.g. a route's content slot).
Optional line describing what is loading (e.g. "Cargando módulo…").
Accessible label for the spinner. Defaults to the message or "Cargando".
Tone for the spinner accent.

paquetes.usarCuando: Siempre: importar tokens.css una vez por app; usar var(--lb-*) o las clases de Tailwind lb-*.
paquetes.evitarCuando: No escribir colores en hexadecimal en las apps.

paquetes.resumen: Texto de ayuda breve al pasar el mouse o enfocar con teclado (role="tooltip", aria-describedby), se cierra con Escape.
paquetes.usarCuando: Explicar un botón de solo icono o un dato abreviado.
paquetes.evitarCuando: Información importante o acciones: muéstrala en la página o usa Menu/Modal. En móvil no hay hover: no ocultes ahí lo esencial.

componentes.descripcion:
Texto de ayuda al pasar el mouse o enfocar con el teclado; se cierra con Escape. Se asocia al
elemento con aria-describedby. No pongas acciones dentro: usa Menu o Modal.

props.descripcion: Elemento que lo dispara (un botón, un icono con foco). Debe aceptar ref y eventos.
Texto del tooltip (breve, sin elementos interactivos).
Espera en ms antes de mostrarse al pasar el mouse (por defecto 300).
Posición: top (por defecto), bottom, left o right.

iconos.usarPara: Botón de crear o agregar un registro.
Copiar un valor al portapapeles o duplicar.
Abrir o aplicar filtros de una lista.
Registrar una salida o cerrar sesión.
Volver o ir al elemento anterior.
Ir al siguiente paso o elemento.
Abrir el detalle de una fila o tarjeta.
Ir al inicio o al final (paginación).
Cerrar un modal, panel o aviso.
Enlace a la página de inicio.
Abrir el menú lateral en móvil.
Marca simple de seleccionado o hecho.
Indicador de carga en línea (en botones).
Archivar registros o ver el histórico.
Asistente de IA o proceso automático.
Seguridad o verificación en dos pasos.
Ajustes de la cuenta del usuario.
Exportar a Excel o hojas de cálculo.
